verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Mugende baana bange:
Ne baddamu Ka tugende;

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Ekitiibwa kibe gy'oli,
Yajja-okufiirira abantu,
Kitaawe ng'amutuma:
N'amalawo-ebibi byaffe,
Ggwe-okufa tokyaluma.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Amakondere ga Jjubiri,
Gavuga mu nsi zonna:
Gategeeza-obulokozi
Eri-amawanga gonna.
Ssetaani n'obuyinza bwe,
Binaatera-okuggwaawo:
Obwakabaka bwa Yesu,
Bujja,obutavaawo.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Kale bannange,twesibe,
Tulwane nnyo masajja:
Tuleme okugayaala,
Mukama waffe ajja.
Laba emmambya esaze,
Ekizikiza kidduka;
Kusembedde-okuwummula,
Tunaatera-okunnyuka.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Naye wakyasigaddeyo
Okulwana-ekiseera,
Tulyoke tugende gy'ali
Tugabirwe empeera.
Weewaawo,nze njija mangu,
